method: client_ghost_baseline_ms() runs 10 repeated bounded BFS passes over the synth-500 bundle and returns the median wall-clock time. Live HydraDB p50/p95 are filled by `scripts/bench_latency.py` against a running stack. For Judge Mode Q&A latency, use docs/results/judge-latency.json (measured).

percentiles.note: Live Ghost/ping latency is not fabricated here. Official Judge Mode latency proof is docs/results/judge-latency.json (p50_ms 6.62, p95_ms 11.43). Populate these fields with `scripts/bench_latency.py` against a live stack.

limitations: Fixture BFS time is measured in-process on the developer machine; actual time is hardware-dependent.
Live HydraDB p50/p95 in this file require scripts/bench_latency.py; until then prefer judge-latency.json for Q&A proof.
The 124,750 client-equivalent round-trips assumes one shortest-path query per pair for 500 people.
